verdict.rationale: Greptile ships a CLI (`greptile review`) that reviews the feature-branch diff locally before a PR is opened, and an MCP server that lets Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and Codex fetch/apply review comments from within the editor — both of which support a pre-push, in-editor review workflow. However, this is CLI/MCP-based rather than a dedicated IDE extension, and there's no evidence of live, as-you-type review inside the editor. Missing for 10: a native IDE plugin/extension for real-time in-editor review, and independent user reports confirming the pre-push CLI/MCP workflow catches issues before push.
